subject: Charged twice for one order
body: The customer was billed twice and asked for the extra charge to be reversed.
approved_reply: I confirmed both charges on the order and reversed the extra one.

subject: Tracking stuck at label created
body: The shipment has not moved for several days.
approved_reply: I checked the shipment. Tracking is still at label created, and I cannot promise a new delivery date.

subject: Damaged item refund
body: The headphones arrived damaged and the customer wants a refund to the original payment method.
approved_reply: I confirmed the order and refunded the damaged item to the original payment method.
